notes.title: Update 4.6.0
notes.content:
What's changed:

 Updated game engine to latest.
 Fixed bugs reported on forums.
 Added LAN mode support for arcade partners.
 Updated custom launcher for arcade partners.
 Exposed Arcade mode config files. You are free to modify and customize arcade mode now.

notes.title: Update 4.5.3 - bHaptics and eSports !
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25275929/f211ea8ddfd8b9fd31f141a8fd4e6e3efe44ee28.jpg

Added bHaptics support. 
Each weapon feedback effect were carefully designed and tested.
Blast wave effects based on direction.
Full support for vest, hand and face modules!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25275929/9243cff8a3eab3d20ee39898d2fd2c3a8e0a5cbb.jpg
Totally redesigned Arcade mode to make it more competitive!

 Tons of new features, changes and fixes.
 Game Engine upgrade.
 New leaderboard.
 Manual reload mode gives 2x score!
 Killstreacks and headshot score boost.
 Note to VR Arcade partner. Please contact for instructions on new command list to modify arcade mode.

NOTE: Story mode saves are not compatible with new version.

Please report bugs found on Steam forums.
Thanks for your support all those years!

Hotfix 4.5.1
Fixed few Arcade COOP mode bugs.

Hotfix 4.5.2
Fixes in Arcade and COOP modes:

 Fix : joining other player in single player mode of Arcade.
 Fix : Steam Arcade Leaderboard scores not reporting in some cases.
 Medium and Hard modes will give player higher scores.
 Harder enemies at Medium and Hard modes.

Hotfix 4.5.3
Fix : Arcade stats do not reset on next round.

notes.title: Update 3.0.2 - new Minigames (WIP) and fixes
notes.content:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25275929/6a43abaf73a983b2dce9ff7e139471db8155293a.gif


Updated Steamworks library.
Several fixes for dual hand weapon handling.
Added 2 minigames Sniper and Zombie Invasion in range map (WIP)
Control change: Dual hand weapon do not require left grip to be pressed all the time. Click one to enter mode, another click to exit.
Sniper scope zoom can be changed in dual hand mode using Left Touch up and down clicks.
Game visual tuning.
Fixed Arcade mode scores are not reported correctly to Steam leaderboards.
Manual reload mode tuned, weapon magazines re-positioned.
AKM added proper GP25 model.
In Arcade mode when manual reload work now if selected in main menu.


Please provide feedback on new features and controls. Sniper is still WIP and we look for optimal control schemes for it.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xGL9Y5fDmr4

Thanks for reporting very rare bug when bio grenades will not spawn again after first throw - fixed.
Bio lab interior updated.
Few minor visual and logic bug fixed.

Player size adjusted.
Organ quest fixed.

notes.title: Update #5 - Performance and lighting
notes.content:
Update #5 - performance and lighting
More performance options have been exposed with this update along with some level tuning and fixes. Here's small guide for each option.

Camera far Plane - how far objects can be seen in meters. Less value more fps, higher more eye candy.

Anti Aliasing - if disabled more fps but edges will look juggy. Maximum is 8AA, image will get more clear with some performance cost.

Environment VFX - Turn on/ff some environment effect like fog/dust/falling leafs etc.

Occlusion culling - when on will hide objects which are far and camera not seeing but may cause some far away objects flickering artifacts.

Foliage Density - how dense is grass and bushes around player. higher values more candy less performance.

Tree Distance - How far to draw trees in meters. Low value - performance boost. Higher more trees.

Detail Radius - in meters border where to draw Grass and bushes etc. Lower value more performance.

I hope with those setting everybody can find comfortable setup for them self while we continue working adding more features and gameplay elements.

1. Made AKM 3x stronger. If its too overkill then we can add less ammo for it.
2. Made Zombies to make more noise so less "OMG do not look back" moments.
3. Reloading weapons mapped from Left Grip to Trigger. Testing if more comfortable.
4. Adjusted Zombie sizes, and add more randomness.
5. Updated make screenshot code. No lags anymore.
6. Added more zombie spawn points.
7. Added Random spawn points for player.
8. Optimizing CPU load and FPS. SO far so good. +20 FPS on AVG.
9. Adding correct hand poses.
10. Upgrade to Unity 5.4 B21.
11. Convert project to Lab renderer.
12. New sounds for AKM and M9A1.
